criteria.description: How quickly can users install and use the plugin?
How many Claude Code users can discover and access it?
Does it create infrastructure reusable for other Eidos plugins?

Does it reduce the launch complexity (flags, workarounds, dual-start)?

question: Should slack-eidos-cc be published to the Claude Code plugin marketplace, and if so, what's the optimal distribution strategy?
context: slack-eidos-cc is a two-way Slack channel plugin for Claude Code built by Eidos AGI. Currently works as a development plugin (--plugin-dir). 120 tests, CI, lib.ts extraction complete. The official Telegram/Discord/iMessage channel plugins are bundled in anthropics/claude-plugins-official. Third-party plugins submit via clau.de/plugin-directory-submission. Alternative: private marketplace for team distribution without Anthropic review. Key consideration: there's already a "slack" plugin in the marketplace (Slack's official MCP read-only integration) — our plugin would need a different name. Daniel (Eidos AGI) built this for Greenmark engagement but it's general-purpose enough for any Claude Code user.
